children.name: text
children: In the Sub-Contract the following words and expressions shall have the following meanings:{br}

children.name: text
children: “Appendix” means the Appendix to the General Terms and Conditions of Sub-Contract annexed hereto.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Conditions” means these General Terms and Conditions of Sub-Contract.{br}

children.name: text
children: “We/Us/Our” means Culena London Limited and/or any of it’s’ subsidiary companies.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Defects Liability Period” means the defects liability period specified in Item 2 of the Appendix, or the period from completion of the Sub-Contract Works until all defects in the Sub-Contract Works have been remedied to Our satisfaction, whichever is the longer.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Employer” means Our employer under the Main Contract.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Final Sub-Contract Sum” means the sum to be paid to You calculated in accordance with Clause 18(k) and (l) hereof.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Period of Reply” means the time period as identified in the Appendix.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Main Contract” means the contract which We have entered into with the Employer.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Site” means the location where the Sub-Contract Works are to be carried out.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Sub-Contract” means this sub-contract between Us and You, comprising of these conditions, the Appendix, the Sub-Contract Order/Agreement and any other documents referred to therein. It shall also include the provisions of the Main Contract.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Sub-Contract Order/Agreement” means the sub-contract order/agreement document.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Sub-Contract Sum” means the sum to be paid to You by Us for carrying out the Sub-Contract Works.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Sub-Contract Works” means the works to be carried out by You as described in the Sub-Contract.{br}

children.name: text
children: “You / Your” means the sub-contractor named in the Sub-Contract.{br}

children.name: text
children: “SWMP” means Our Site Waste Management Plan.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Day” means calendar day unless stated otherwise.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Works” means all work to be designed and/or supplied, and/or work to be performed by the Sub-Contractor including, repair, modification or reconstruction, all as set out in or reasonably to be inferred from the specification or description of works.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Suspect” means evidence exists that the part may be Fraudulent or Counterfeit.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Fraudulent” means misrepresented as meeting requirements, includes used parts represented as new parts.{br}

children.name: text
children: “Counterfeit” means Fraudulent goods that have been confirmed as being a copy, imitation or substitute that has been represented, identified, or marked as genuine, and/or altered by a source without legal right with intent to mislead, deceive or defraud.{br}

children.name: text
children: All parties named in this Sub-Contract agreement shall act as stated in this contract and in a spirit of mutual trust and co-operation.{br}

children.name: text
children: This Sub-Contract is supplemental to the Main Contract and comprises the design (insofar as the You have designed the Sub-Contract Works) execution completion testing and commissioning (where applicable) and maintenance (to the extent set out in Clause 14) of the Sub-Contract Works and the provision of all labour materials plant (as defined in Clause 14) temporary works and services as far as the necessity for providing the same is specified herein. All other terms and conditions of Your quotation or tender are excluded save such terms and conditions We have expressly accepted in writing. No other variation or substitution for or addition to these Conditions shall be binding otherwise than by agreement in writing by both parties.{br}

children.name: text
children: The prices set out in this Sub-Contract include all payments and expenses which may be payable to You in respect of Your proper execution and completion of the Sub-Contract Works. It includes any labour, materials, plant and equipment required. You shall be taken to have included everything necessary for the proper and timely execution of Your Works. Your price(s) also include(s) any and all increases in the same that may occur after the date of Your offer.{br}

children.name: text
children: {b:Your Compliance with the Main Contract Conditions}{br}

children.name: text
children: Item 1 of the Appendix to this Sub-Contract identifies the Main Contract We are to comply with.{br}

children.name: text
children: You are bound by and shall observe perform and comply with every provision of the Main Contract insofar as they relate to or apply to any portion of or all of Your Works which are not inconsistent with the express provisions of this Sub-Contract as if the Main Contract was fully set out herein.{br}

children.name: text
children: (i) Any breach non-observance or non-performance by You, Your servants or agents of any or all of the conditions of the Main Contract; and{br}
(ii) Your acts or omissions including those of Your servants or agents which involves Us in any liability to the Employer or any third party; and{br}

children.name: text
children: (iii) Any claim loss damage or expense due to or resulting from any negligence or breach of duty on Your part and/or that of Your servants or agents. This shall include (but shall not be limited to) any wrongful use of scaffolding or any other property not belonging to or provided by You.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall not assign this Sub-Contract without Our express written consent.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall not sub-let the Sub-Contract Works or any part of the Works without our express written consent.{br}

children.name: text
children: Save in respect of any permitted assignments or sub-lets, no provision of the Sub-Contract is intended to or shall confer upon any third party any benefit or enforceable right at the option of that third party or any liability whatsoever on any third party.{br}

children.name: text
children: Where applicable, You shall design execute complete test commission and maintain the Sub-Contract Works to Our satisfaction. You shall comply with Our instructions and directions on any matter concerning the Sub-Contract Works, the Site and any matters related to them.{br}

children.name: text
children: Where applicable You shall ensure that plumb lines levels dimensions and tolerances are all in accordance with the Main Contract drawings before commencing the Sub-Contract Works and You shall also assist Us in taking levels checking dimensions examining work and any like requirements whenever required. In the absence of such information, You must obtain written approval of dimensions from Us in good time to allow you to properly complete the Sub-Contract Works.{br}

children.name: text
children: Where Your execution of the Sub-Contract Works requires work by Us such as providing for fixings leaving holes forming chases or like work You shall provide Us with all information We require for such work to be undertaken in a timely fashion so as to maintain the construction programme under the Main Contract at all times. You will be charged with any additional costs that We may incur or losses which We suffer from Your failure to comply with this requirement.{br}

children.name: text
children: You will give Us and the Employer, plus any persons duly authorised by either the Employer or Us access at all reasonable times to any work being prepared for or undertaken and which will be utilised in the Sub-Contract Works. For the avoidance of doubt, this shall include access to any preparatory drawings, documents, instructions or other information prepared or used by you for the Sub-Contract Works.{br}

children.name: text
children: It is a condition of this Sub-Contract that You satisfactorily complete Our prequalification process for inclusion on our “Approved” Sub-Contractor database prior to commencement of any works on site – this incorporates providing (and maintaining throughout the duration of your works on site) all required accreditations and relevant insurances. In order to maintain Your “Approved” status You shall on reasonable notice from Us comply with any request for relevant information relating to Your status on Our Approved Sub-Contractor Database within 14 days of such notice. For clarity, should Your approval expire and You fail to respond with relevant information and/or documents You shall be in breach of this Sub-Contract.{br}

children.name: text
children: We may instruct any variation to the form quality or quantity of the Sub-Contract Works or any part thereof.{br}

children.name: text
children: No variation shall vitiate this Sub-Contract or any part of it.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall not make or act upon any variation unless We have first given written authority to do so. Variations We authorise in writing shall be valued in accordance with the schedules of rates forming part of the Sub-Contract. Where there are no such schedules, the variation shall be measured and valued at fair and reasonable rates unless any other basis is agreed upon in writing. Any other variation shall not entitle any reimbursement unless we expressly agree in writing.{br}

children.name: text
children: It shall be a condition precedent to payment for any variation that within the Period of Reply from the date of the instruction or commencement of variation works (whichever is the earlier) instructed by Us, You shall prepare a written statement setting out the anticipated financial implications of the variation and submit the statement along with full particulars to which You claim You are entitled to and submit this to Us failing which You shall have no entitlement to payment for any variation and as a result of Your breach of contract you shall not be entitled to rely upon any breach of contract or act of prevention on Our part. For the avoidance of any doubt, the extra cost submitted by You shall not be deemed to be accepted by the provision of such particulars or any lack of response by Us and shall be assessed in accordance with Clause 18 of these terms.{br}

children.name: text
children: If We require you to do so, You shall provide Us with returns of wages or time sheets and returns of materials and plant at times instructed by Us. You shall also make available all records necessary for Us to properly check such returns.{br}

children.name: text
children: Only daywork instructed by Us in writing and fully and accurately recorded by You on a daywork sheet authorised by our representative shall be payable by Us. It is a condition precedent to payment that Your sheets are submitted daily to Our agent or Quantity Surveyor for signature not later than noon on the next working day following the day on which the work was executed failing which You shall have no entitlement to payment for such daywork and as a result of Your breach of contract you shall not be entitled to rely upon any breach of contract or act of prevention on Our part.{br}

children.name: text
children: It is a further condition precedent to payment for any daywork that You submit the signed copy of the daywork sheet with Your next application for payment after the date which the daywork sheet relates to. Any failure to comply with this clause 7(g) shall mean You shall have no entitlement to payment for such daywork. As a result of Your breach of contract you shall not be entitled to rely upon any breach of contract or act of prevention on Our part.{br}

children.name: text
children: The agent’s signature shall not signify Our agreement that the work shall be allowed at any rates that may be entered on the daywork sheet or that the time spent is a reasonable period of time for the completion of the tasks described therein. It shall only signify that the sheet contains a correct record of the hours worked and materials plant and equipment supplied.{br}

children.name: text
children: Works carried out on daywork in accordance with this clause 7 shall be calculated and valued in accordance with item 12 of the Appendix hereto.{br}

children.name: text
children: You will visit and inspect the Site and acquaint Yourself with every part of the Sub-Contract Works. You will pay attention to and take note of the conditions including means of access and any difficulties which may arise. You shall keep Us fully informed of any concerns You may have.{br}

children.name: text
children: You accept by entering into this Sub-Contract or commencing work that You have satisfied Yourself of the nature, extent and location of the Site, including the conditions on the Site, the availability of necessary equipment and facilities and any other matter which may affect the execution of the Sub-Contract Works.{br}

children.name: text
children: We do not give any warranty as to the accuracy or sufficiency of any information We provide to You. We shall not be liable to You or anyone else for any loss whatsoever arising from insufficient or inaccurate information.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall indemnify Us against any liability loss claim or proceedings whatsoever arising under any statute or at common law in respect of personal injury to or the death of any person whomsoever and of any injury or damage whatsoever to any property real or personal arising out of or in the course of or caused by the carrying out of the Sub-Contract Works. This clause shall apply unless and to the extent that any such liability loss claim or proceedings is due to any act or negligence by Us, Our servants or agents.{br}

children.name: text
children: Without prejudice to Your obligation to indemnify Us under Clause 9(a) You shall take out and maintain insurance as required by Clause 9(c) in respect of claims arising out of any liability referred to in Clause 9(a).{br}

children.name: text
children: The insurance in respect of claims for personal injury to or the death of any person under a contract of service or apprenticeship with You, and arising out of and in the course of such person’s employment, shall comply with relevant legislation. For all other claims to which Clause 9(a) applies the insurance cover:{br}{br}(i) shall indemnify Us in like manner to You but only to the extent that You may be liable to indemnify Us under the terms of the Sub-Contract; and{br}(ii) shall have a limit of indemnity of not less than the sum stated in item 13 of the Appendix hereto.{br}

children.name: text
children: Your Sub-Contract Works and the materials and goods and construction plant tools and equipment properly on the Site for incorporation in the Sub-Contract Works shall be at Your own risk. You shall, until the date of commencement of the Defects Liability Period, be responsible for and shall make good any loss or damage to the Sub-Contract Works and repair or replace as necessary any materials plant tools and equipment and shall insure the same for their full reinstatement value except to the extent that any loss or damage is due to Our negligence omission or default, or that of the Employer.{br}

children.name: text
children: Without in any way altering or limiting Your liability where under the Main Contract the Employer or We are obliged to maintain insurances in joint names of the Employer, Ourselves and You the benefit of such insurances shall be available to You and Your obligation to maintain insurance under this Clause 9 shall be so varied but only to the extent provided by the Main Contract insurance provisions and the cover provided by the policies effected in pursuance thereto. Where joint named insurances are made available, You shall observe and comply with the terms and conditions of such insurances and indemnify Us against any failure by You to observe or comply with those terms.{br}

children.name: text
children: Upon Our written request You shall provide Us with suitable documentary evidence that the insurance required by this Clause 9 is being maintained. In the event of Your insurance being withdrawn, cancelled or otherwise materially altered you shall inform us in writing immediately. In doing so, You shall set out the precise reasons for the change together with how you have addressed such issues to comply with Your obligations under this Agreement.{br}

children.name: text
children: You must observe and comply with all current health safety and environmental legislation, approved codes of practice, guidance issued by the Health and Safety Executive, Our Health & Safety Requirements with regards to PPE and all relevant British Standards at all times during the Sub-Contract Works. Please note that We have a mandatory gloves policy in place and that Rigger/Dealer style safety boots are not permitted on any on Our sites unless sanctioned following a risk assessment and approved by a senior manager.{br}

children.name: text
children: You will be liable for any infringement or failure to observe these requirements due to any negligence or breach of duty on the part of the Employer, by Us or by our other Sub-Contractors or any respective servants or agents.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall observe and comply with all rules laid down by Us from time to time relating to the safe conduct of the Sub-Contract Works on the Site and prevention of environmental damage.{br}

children.name: text
children: It shall be a condition precedent to Your payment that You complete the health and safety questionnaire provided by Us to Our satisfaction.{br}

children.name: text
children: Subject to Clauses 7 and this clause 11 You shall forthwith comply with all instructions and/or directions We issue to You on any matter connected with the Sub-Contract Works.{br}

children.name: text
children: If you fail to comply and or do not substantially begin to comply with a written notice from Us within three working days of receipt, We may employ others to execute any work whatsoever necessary to give effect to such instruction without further notice to You. You agree to indemnify Us from and against any loss cost expense and/or damage howsoever suffered or incurred or likely to be suffered or incurred by Us in connection with such employment and We shall be entitled to estimate any such sum and deduct this from any monies due or to become due to You or the sums we incur shall otherwise be immediately recoverable by Us from You as a debt.{br}

children.name: text
children: All instructions and directions We issue shall be issued in writing. You shall not be entitled to recover any payment howsoever arising as a consequence of acting on any instruction or direction from Us that has not been so confirmed in writing in advance, save where compliance with such instruction or direction is urgently required for reasons related to health, safety or the environment. Where urgent instructions or directions are issued verbally, We shall confirm them in writing as soon as reasonably practicable thereafter.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall employ a competent foreman or chargehand on the Site authorised to receive directions from Us on Your behalf. You shall employ only such workmen as are careful skilled and experienced in their trades. We shall be at liberty to require You to remove from the Site any person We consider incompetent negligent or guilty of misconduct relating to his employment or who in Our opinion should not be employed on the Site. Your foreman and workmen shall whenever necessary work in conjunction with other sub-contractors and trades that may be working on the Site.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall pay rates of wages and observe hours and conditions of labour no less favourable than those observed by other employers engaged in the trade or industry in the district or those laid down by national or other agreements.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall comply with all and any Site agreements concerning wages conditions and hours of work.{br}

children.name: text
children: If the Sub-Contract Works fall within a category covered by the National Working Rules Agreement of the National Joint Council for the Building Industry (hereinafter referred to as "the NJCBI") You shall be a registered employer. If You have not registered under clause 2.8 of the NJCBI Memorandum of Agreement and the National Working Rule 26 (Register of Employers) of the NJCBI You shall do so immediately upon entering into the Sub-Contract. You must pay the building trades operatives at the rates of the wages and under the conditions laid down by the NJCBI.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall proceed faithfully and diligently in Your preparation to meet the date(s) for commencement of the Sub-Contract Works. If We decide that Your actions are inadequate to enable You to do so then You shall immediately upon receipt of notification from Us and at Your own expense take whatever steps are necessary to remedy the inadequacy within the period which We notify you of or, in the absence of such a period being identified, urgently and in any event as soon as reasonably practicable.{br}

children.name: text
children: You will commence the Sub-Contract Works on the date or dates for commencement as set out the Appendix, or upon such other commencement date(s) as We may notify to You in writing.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall proceed regularly and diligently with the Sub-Contract Works and complete them within the period(s) or by the date(s) for completion as set out in the Appendix and the Main Contract (or such other period(s) as may We may notify You of in writing). If You consider that there is any reason or likelihood for You being unable to maintain the periods set out within the Appendix or any agreed programme, then you shall immediately inform Us in writing stating the reasons and Your proposals to mitigate any delays. Should you fail to inform Us of any event circumstance or reason which may impact upon your ability to complete the Sub-Contract Works or any other matter which may impact upon the programme of works under the Main Contract within the Period for Reply and We suffer a loss then you shall be liable to and reimburse Us for that loss,{br}

children.name: text
children: (i) If You are delayed in the execution of the Sub-Contract Works by any circumstances or occurrence (other than Your own breach of the Sub-Contract) entitling Us to an extension of time for completion of the Main Contract Works or by any breach of the Sub-Contract by Us then subject to Your compliance with the terms of this Sub-Contract You shall be entitled to such extension of the period for completion of the Sub-Contract Works as may in all the circumstances be fair and reasonable provided that You have given Us written notice of all of the circumstances, occurrences, breach or act of prevention which You consider entitles You to such extension of time within the Period of Reply including the circumstances, occurrence, breach or act and given Us such details thereof as We require (including details of the provisions in the Main Contract pursuant to which the Sub-Contractor considers that the Contractor is entitled to an extension of time for completion of the Main Contract Works) as will enable Us to consider the matter.{br}{br}(ii) We will notify You in writing of any extension awarded under the Main Contract.{br}

children.name: text
children: If it becomes reasonably apparent that You are failing to maintain progress so that the Sub-Contract Works will not be completed by the date(s) or within the period(s) provided for by the Sub-Contract then, without prejudice to any other rights or remedies, We may upon 7 days’ written notice omit any part of the Sub-Contract Works and make arrangements for that part of the Sub-Contract Works to be carried out by others. Our exercise of such a right shall not cause Us to be in breach of the Sub-Contract and You shall not be entitled to treat its employment under the Sub-Contract as determined unless We give You a written notice of determination in accordance with Clauses 20 or 22. We shall be entitled to recover the costs of any loss and/or expense so incurred from You as a debt and You shall not be entitled to any payment for loss of profit or any other loss and/or expense incurred as a result of Our taking over the performance of the Sub-Contract Works or any part thereof.{br}

children.name: text
children: If You fail to commence or complete the Sub-Contract Works or any section thereof by the date(s) or within the period(s) provided for by the Sub-Contract You shall pay or allow Us a sum equal to any loss or damage or liability We suffer (including without prejudice to the generality of the foregoing any liability incurred under the Main Contract) and caused directly or indirectly by Your failure to commence or complete the Sub-Contract Works.{br}

children.name: text
children: Any reference in the Sub-Contract to the period(s) or date(s) for completion of the Sub-Contract Works shall include any extended period(s) or date(s) for completion of the Sub-Contract Works pursuant to this Clause.{br}

children.name: text
children: When You consider that the Sub-Contract Works or any section thereof are to be complete within a period of 2 weeks You shall notify Us in writing by issuing Us with a “Certificate of Completion”. We shall assess the Sub-Contract Works and as soon as reasonably practicable after We consider that completion has been achieved, we shall complete a certificate and send this to You in writing. Unless we state otherwise in writing, Our certificate shall be deemed to be the date of completion.{br}

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provisions within the Sub-Contract at no point shall You gain any entitlement to cost or time due to adverse weather.{br}

children.name: text
children: {b:Quality of Workmanship and Materials, Guarantees, Defects Liability & Waste}{br}

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contract Works shall be carried out using reasonable skill and care and shall be executed to Our satisfaction using the highest quality materials and workmanship. The Sub-Contract Works shall be executed in accordance with all drawings and specifications We provide and (unless inconsistent therewith) shall comply with the latest relevant British Standard specifications and British Standard codes of practice and all amendments.{br}

children.name: text
children: We may reject any work on the grounds of inferior materials or workmanship and require You without delay to make good such work at Your own expense. You shall bear the cost of all direct and indirect loss and damage suffered or that We may suffer and which results either directly or indirectly from such inferior materials or workmanship. Where the Sub-Contract Works include an applied finish to a surface formation or the like (hereinafter referred to as ‘the base’) that has been prepared by others You must satisfy yourself that the base is suitable to receive the Sub-Contract Works. If the base is in any way unsuitable You shall immediately notify Us in writing and await further instruction before proceeding with the Sub-Contract Works. Where the Sub-Contract Works include the provision of materials likely to be affected by atmospheric conditions You must satisfy yourself that the prevailing Site conditions are suitable before delivery application or installation of the material commences. Your non-compliance with this requirement shall not interfere with Your contractual obligations or Your guarantee given or to be given for the Sub-Contract Works.{br}

children.name: text
children: Materials are guaranteed to be new, unused, and in their original packaging and all date codes to match unless otherwise agreed to in writing by both parties.{br}

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall ensure that Counterfeit materials are not supplied. In the event that the Sub-Contractor detects any such Counterfeit materials he shall immediately quarantine the materials and inform Our Project Management in writing. The Sub-Contractor shall then await further instruction from Us. We reserve the right to quarantine suspect counterfeit, fraudulent and counterfeit materials. Payment in this case will be held until the Original Component Manufacturer or appropriate body provides conclusive results whereupon parts may be subject to disposition and details reported to the appropriate authorities. The disclosure of the source and location of supply is to be provided where requested. At this point no payment will be made to You for these materials and as a result of Your breach of contract you shall not be entitled to rely upon any breach of contract or act of prevention on Our part. In cases where payment is made in advance, full reimbursement will be required including any third party testing charges incurred by the Contractor.{br}

children.name: text
children: All guarantees and Test certificates offered within Your tender shall be forwarded to Us in written form prior to completion of the Sub-Contract Works. You shall also provide all relevant and requested certificates and records in order to conform to current legislation in evidencing product conformity and traceability of materials used. This relates to all products incorporated into the permanent construction works as defined in the Construction Products Regulations 2013. Your failure to provide any of the above shall be deemed to mean that the works are not complete.{br}

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provisions of the Sub-Contract, and regardless of the manner in which the Sub-Contract Agreement has been executed, Your liability for latent defects in the Sub-Contract Works, howsoever caused, shall continue for a period of twelve years from completion of the Main Contract Works.{br}

children.name: text
children: If You are a subsidiary company (as defined by section 1159 of the Companies Act 2006) of another company (hereinafter called ‘the Holding Company’) You shall procure that the Holding Company executes a guarantee in a form We supply guaranteeing Your proper performance of Your obligations under the Sub-Contract. It shall be a condition precedent to payment that You comply with this Clause 14(e).{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall take all precautions necessary to prevent damage that may be caused by frost or other atmospheric conditions to the Sub-Contract Works.{br}

children.name: text
children: The Defects Liability Period shall commence on the day following our certificate of completion of the Sub-Contract Works. You shall make good all defects shrinkages or other faults in the Sub-Contract Works which appear during the Defects Liability Period at Your own cost including any repairs to any other part of the Main Contract Works arising out of the Sub-Contractor’s remedial work and any other costs arising from the defect howsoever arising and whether incurred by the Contractor or Employer. You shall carry out such making good within the time period identified within the Main Contract or such other period identified by Us in writing within the Appendix after receipt of Our instruction to You to do so. Should You fail to comply with Your obligations under this Clause 14(g) within our stated time or, if We do not state a time the period under the Main Contract for the rectification of defects We may make arrangements for the execution of such remedial works by others and You shall bear all of Our costs expenses and losses in connection with any remedial works so carried out. On completion of the Sub-Contract Works (and when requested).{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall support Us by contributing to a project review to identify what could be improved and what went well.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall provide information on the method of materials delivery, unloading and storage whilst on Site, including transport to the workface, identifying ways in which waste will be reduced.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall advise Us upon the level of recycled content in major materials to be supplied, supply materials with a higher level of recycled content where technically and commercially viable and wherever possible provide written evidence of the use of these materials e.g. in the form of datasheets.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall support the development of the SWMP and Us and will:{br}{br}(i) identify the wastage rate applied to each material, explaining the need for this level of wastage allowance and how it has been reduced;{br}{br}(ii) identify actions that it will take to reduce this level of waste, showing any additional costs or savings achieved by these measures;{br}{br}(iii) participate in Site briefings for operatives on materials handling and waste disposal; and{br}{br}(iv) Provide an accurate forecast of the types and quantities of waste that will be produced by the Sub-Contract Works (inclusive of packaging waste).{br}{br}(v) identify how packaging waste arising on Site will be reduced.{br}

children.name: text
children: You will support Us during the carrying out of the Sub-Contract Works by:{br}{br}(i) working in full compliance with the methods detailed within the SWMP – in particular complying with all actions to reduce and reuse waste and increase levels of recovery;{br}{br}(ii) informing Us in advance of any deviations from the SWMP with justifying reasons;{br}{br}(iii) identifying additional ways to reduce and reuse waste and/or increase recovery and informing Us of the same;{br}{br}(iv) complying with the Site waste segregation strategy, including the avoidance of cross-contamination of segregated (non-mixed) skips; and{br}{br}(v) ensuring that materials and waste are stored in a safe and tidy manner and that waste is disposed of (in an appropriate skip or other agreed receptacle) at the earliest opportunity.{br}

children.name: text
children: From time to time as instructed by Us You shall clear away and remove from the Site all rubbish arising from the execution of the Sub-Contract Works. If You fail to clear away rubbish as instructed then We may clear away the rubbish at Your cost and expense.{br}

children.name: text
children: Where You have responsibility for removal of construction, demolition or excavation waste You shall:{br}{br}(i) comply with all relevant legislation including the Environmental Protection (Duty of Care) Regulations 1991;{br}{br}(ii) meet the recovery targets as specified at the pre-award meeting;{br}{br}(iii) meet the recovery targets for demolition, strip-out and excavation materials as specified at the pre-award meeting;{br}{br}(iv) meet the data and reporting requirements as specified in 14(c);{br}{br}(v) aim to maximise the reuse of demolition and excavation waste arising;{br}{br}(vi) identify ways to increase the recovery rate of materials by finding end-destinations with high recovery rates; and{br}{br}(vii) advise on waste management actions most appropriate to each project.{br}

children.name: text
children: Where You have responsibility for removal of construction waste, You shall:{br}{br}(i) provide Us with a copy of Your Waste Carrier’s Registration before starting the Sub-Contract Works;{br}{br}(ii) provide details of the end-destination of all movements of waste, including the name and address of the destination, the type of facility and the recovery rate for that material;{br}{br}(iii) report on the different types of waste managed, and the split of each different type of waste according to the waste management method (reuse, recycling, recovery, landfill and other) and, in the case of reuse, recycling and recovery, whether this has taken place on or off Site;{br}{br}(iv) monitor and report monthly (within 2 weeks of the end of the reporting period) in line with agreed industry methods for waste measurement and reporting (available from Waste and Resources Action Programme (“WRAP”)), the quantities in tonnes and percentage recovery rates for construction, demolition and excavation waste streams separately;{br}{br}(v) submit quarterly relevant data in the form of an Environment Agency Return from the waste transfer station to the Contractor; and{br}{br}(vi) use a systematic process to record and check waste, recovery and recycling data which is available for inspection on request.{br}

children.name: text
children: Except as may be varied by Clauses 15(b), (c) and (d) You shall provide all constructional plant and equipment whether of a specialist nature or otherwise and whether mechanical or non-mechanical necessary for the due performance of the Sub-Contract Works.{br}

children.name: text
children: Where We are to provide scaffolding and hoists required for the execution of the Sub-Contract Works such scaffolding and hoists shall be of a type and quantity We shall determine and shall be available to You only the period necessary for completing that section of the Sub-Contract Works. Should You require specific alterations to the scaffold in order to carry out the Sub-Contract works You must give Us notice of those alterations 7 days in advance of them being required or such other time as may be reasonably required if 7 days is likely to be insufficient. You will be charged any costs We incur in retaining such scaffolding and hoists as a result of Your delay. You must satisfy Yourself at all times as to the fitness condition and suitability of such scaffolding and hoists and that such scaffolding and hoists comply with statutory safety regulations, as We shall hold no responsibility or liability for the same.{br}

children.name: text
children: Where You are to provide and erect scaffolding and hoists required for the execution of the Sub-Contract Works or are to be provided by Us and erected by You then such scaffolding and hoists shall comply with all statutory safety regulations and shall be of a type and quantity to be agreed with Our agent in advance. You will be charged with any costs We incur by such scaffolding and hoists remaining in position beyond the period for completion of that section of the Sub-Contract Works as a result of Your delay.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall ensure that all of Your operatives who are at any time required to erect alter or dismantle scaffolding and are employed under the agreement of the NJCBI or the Civil Engineering Construction Conciliation Board (hereinafter referred to as the ‘CECCB’) and shall satisfy the requirements of the Construction Industry Scaffolders’ Record Scheme as set out in the Working Rules of the NJCBI and of the CECCB.{br}

children.name: text
children: Where You are responsible for the design of the Sub-Contract Works or any part thereof You warrant and undertake that You have exercised and will at all times exercise all the skill and care to be expected of a duly qualified and experienced designer undertaking the design of works similar in scope and character to the Sub-Contract Works and ensure it does not specify for use or authorise or approve the specification or use by others of:{br}

i) products goods or materials generally known at the time of specification to be deleterious to health and safety or to the durability of buildings and/or other structures and/or finishes and/or plant and machinery in the particular circumstances in which they are used;{br}

ii) products goods or materials which do not accord with British or European Union Standards and/or Codes of Practice current at the time of specification or such equivalent standards or requirements and good building and engineering practice;{br}

iii) products goods or materials which do not accord with the guidelines contained in the edition of the publication “Good Practice in the Selection of Construction Materials” (British Council for Offices) current at the time of specification; or{br}

iv) products goods or materials which could reasonably be considered to be Counterfeit or which are not otherwise delivered directly from the Original Component Manufacturer or Original Equipment Manufacturer, or through an Original Component Manufacturer or Original Equipment Manufacturer authorised distributor chain.{br}

If in the performance of Your duties under this Sub-Contract You become aware that You or any other party has specified or used or authorised or approved the specification or use by others of any such products or materials referred to in this clause You shall notify Us in writing forthwith. This clause does not create any additional duty for You to inspect or check the work of others which is not required by the other provisions of the Sub-Contract Works.{br}

children.name: text
children: You hereby warrant the adequacy and accuracy of all designs for which You are responsible (the “Designs”) and guarantee that the Designs shall be carried out using reasonable skill and care and are suitable for the purpose for which they are intended, which shall include ensuring the Designs are suitable and in keeping and wholly compatible with the Main Contract. In acknowledging sole responsibility and liability for the Designs You hereby acknowledge that any comments or representations We may make are entirely without prejudice to Your liabilities and responsibilities under the Sub-Contract.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall ensure that You:{br}{br}(i) develop a design solution that minimises waste and is technically and commercially viable and record these in the SWMP;{br}{br}(ii) quantify the level of waste anticipated from the design, and use this to inform the wastage allowances applied to the materials order; and{br}{br}(iii) work with the project team to ensure that design actions to reduce construction waste and increase reused and recycled content are implemented.{br}

children.name: text
children: The copyright in all Designs You prepare shall remain vested in Us. We shall have an irrevocable, non-exclusive, non-terminable, royalty-free licence (such licence carrying the right to grant sub-licences and to be transferable with Your permission (which shall not be unreasonably withheld)) to copy and use the Designs and to reproduce the Designs and content of them for any purpose relating to the Sub-Contract Works including the construction, completion, extension, reconstruction, modification, repair, use, letting, sale and advertisement of the Sub-Contract Works. You warrant that the Designs are Your own work and their use in connection with the Sub-Contract Works will not infringe the rights of any third party. If the use of the Designs is found to infringe the rights of any third person, the Sub-Contractor shall indemnify the Contractor against all resulting expenses, liability, losses, damage, claims or proceedings.{br}

children.name: text
children: Insofar as You are responsible for design of the Sub-Contract Works or any part thereof, You shall hold and maintain professional indemnity insurance and/or product liability insurance in an amount specified in the Appendix for any one occurrence or series of occurrences arising out of any one event at all times until 12 years after the date of practical completion of the Main Contract Works.{br}

children.name: text
children: If any aspect of Your design is undertaken whether in whole or in part by any third party, You shall ensure that any third party is fully conversant with the Site, these terms and conditions of this Sub-Contract and the Main Contract. You shall ensure that any third party is fully qualified and experienced in the works it is to undertake, shall hold suitable insurance in the amounts as specified by this Agreement and shall comply with all of the terms of this Agreement and Main Contract in exactly the same way as You are required under these terms.{br}

children.name: text
children: You warrant that You shall upon Our request and prior to the third party being appointed at no additional charge to Us or the Employer obtain a collateral warranty to our satisfaction from the third party designer and that the provision of such documentation is a condition precedent to payment under this Sub-Contract. For the avoidance of any doubt nothing within this Clause 16 in any way limits or mitigates Your liability to Us under this Sub-Contract.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall be solely responsible for the delivery acceptance unloading checking placing into position storage safe custody of all materials plant constructional plant and equipment and for any matters arising in connection with them.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall be solely responsible for ensuring that all deliveries of goods materials plant and equipment is undertaken in sufficient time to allow the diligent and prompt execution of the Sub-Contract Works and shall ensure that all public holidays, delivery lead times or other potential causes of delay howsoever arising have been properly considered. You shall indemnify Us from and against any and all costs losses demands claims and liabilities (which for the avoidance of doubt shall include any loss of profit We may suffer) as a result of any delay to the Sub-Contract Works or to the Main Contract.{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall carry the whole risk of any and all loss by theft or otherwise and or damage, subject to Clause 9(e).{br}

children.name: text
children: Should arrangements be made whereby We or Our subcontractors or agents unload Your materials plant constructional plant or equipment you acknowledge and accept that this is undertaken at Your own risk and expense. We do not accept any liability or responsibility for such unloading.{br}

children.name: text
children: Subject to and in accordance with the Main Contract at the times therein mentioned We shall make application to the Employer under the Main Contract for payment of the amount which at the time and based upon Your applications for payment fairly represents the value of the Sub-Contract Works and of the materials and goods delivered upon the Site for use in the Sub-Contract Works.{br}

children.name: text
children: For the purposes of this Clause 18, “Relevant Period” shall mean the 7 days before each month end (unless otherwise advised by Our Commercial Manager).{br}

children.name: text
children: Until We certify completion, You shall submit applications for payment on account of the Sub-Contract Sum to Us not later than 5 working days before the last working day of the calendar month following the month of commencement of the Sub-Contract Works and each subsequent calendar month thereafter.{br}

children.name: text
children: Each application shall specify the sum You reasonably consider to be due at the payment due date (as determined in accordance with this Clause 18) and the basis on which that sum is calculated which must be accompanied by full substantiation of the sums claimed. When calculating the sum due, You shall only include the value of work carried out in accordance with the Sub-Contract up to the end of each Relevant Period. It shall be a condition precedent to payment becoming due that You comply with this Clause 18(d).{br}

children.name: text
children: Your applications for payment shall only include the value of materials and goods from such time as they are reasonably, properly and not prematurely brought upon the Site and then only if adequately stored and/or protected against weather and other casualties, unless We expressly agree in writing. Where We expressly agree and where You make application for payment for materials or goods delivered to the Site or held on Your premises such application for payment must be accompanied by a letter from You certifying that such materials or goods are free from any reservation of title claim charge or encumbrance and that You can pass good title. Upon Our payment to You for goods or materials the property in the goods or materials shall pass unreservedly to Us and where such goods and materials are held upon Your premises they shall be set aside properly marked as being Our property and a certificate of ownership shall be immediately supplied to Us by You.{br}

children.name: text
children: The amount of any payment due to You from Us by way of periodic payments shall be the amount determined in accordance with sub-clause (g) less the amount determined in accordance with sub-clause (h) and less the amount determined in accordance with sub-clause (i). For the avoidance of doubt all such payments prior to the Final Subcontract Application shall be payments on account We shall be entitled to set off, amend or rectify any errors or discrepancies in any of Our periodic assessments or payments.{br}

children.name: text
children: The amount determined in accordance with this sub-clause shall be the aggregate of the following amounts:{br}{br}(i) an amount equal to the value of any work performed in accordance with these Conditions during the period from the commencement of the Sub-Contract Works to the end of the Relevant Period excluding any amount calculated in accordance with Clause 18(g)(ii) hereof;{br}{br}(ii) subject to sub-clause 18(e) an amount equal to the value of any materials and goods manufactured on the Site or brought onto the Site for the purpose of the Sub-Contract Works during the period from commencement of the Sub-Contract Works to the end of the Relevant Period;{br}{br}(iii) an estimate of the value of work executed in accordance with variation orders issued to You by Us; and{br}{br}(iv) any other sums or amounts which become payable under the Sub-Contract during or in respect of the period from the commencement of the Sub-Contract Works to the end of the Relevant Period.{br}

children.name: text
children: From the amount determined in accordance with sub-clause 18(g) shall be deducted:{br}{br}(i) Retention money which shall be dealt with in accordance with items 6, 7, 8 & 9 of the Appendix;{br}{br}(ii) Any discount in accordance with item 5 of the Appendix; and{br}{br}(iii) Any deductions that the Contractor is required to make or is entitled to make pursuant to the Sub-Contract.{br}

children.name: text
children: We may deduct from the amount determined in accordance with sub-clauses 18(g) and (h) the aggregate of any sums paid or are due for payment by way of periodic payments during the period from the commencement of the Sub-Contract Works to the end of the Relevant Period.{br}

children.name: text
children: Any payment of a kind mentioned in Clause 18(f) shall become due 21 days following the end of the Relevant Period.{br}

children.name: text
children: The Final Sub-Contract Sum payable under the Sub-Contract shall be the amount equal to the difference, if any, between:{br}{br}(i) the Sub-Contract Sum adjusted in accordance with these Conditions less the discount in accordance with item 5 of the Appendix hereto; and{br}{br}(ii) the aggregate of any periodic payments which have become due under the Sub-Contract,{br}

children.name: text
children: Taking into account any revisions by Us to address any errors or discrepancies in any periodic assessment by Us and/or periodic payments to You{br}(i) After we have certified completion, You shall not submit more than 2 further applications for payment, one of which must be your final application for payment. Any other applications submitted shall not be accepted, nor entitle any claim for payment under these terms.{br}{br}(ii) Not later than 4 months after completion of the Sub-Contract Works You shall send Us a final application for payment which complies with Clause 18(c) and 18(d) and is accompanied by all documents necessary for the purpose of calculating the Final Sub-Contract Sum.{br}{br}(iii) Not later than 8 months after Our receipt of the documents referred to in Clause 18(l)(ii) We shall prepare and send You a statement of the calculation of the Final Sub-Contract Sum. The due date for payment of the Final Sub-Contract Sum shall be 9 months after Our receipt of the documents referred to in Clause 18(l)(ii).{br}{br}(iv) If You do not submit the documents referred to in Clause 18(l)(i) to Us within 4 months of practical completion of the Sub-Contract Works We may, ascertain the Sub-Contract Sum which sum shall be calculated in accordance with sub-clauses (k)(l) and (k)(ii) and shall incorporate such other adjustments which are in accordance with these Conditions We can calculate with the information in Our possession. This calculation shall form the final decision of the Contract Sum, which shall be binding upon You.{br}

children.name: text
children: The final date for the making of any payment under the Sub-Contract shall be 35 days from the date that payment becomes due.{br}

children.name: text
children: Not later than 5 days after the date on which any payment becomes due We shall give You a written notice specifying the sum We consider to be or have been due at the due date and the basis on which that sum is calculated (the “Payment Notice”). The sum We consider to be due shall be calculated by reference to Your relevant application for payment. If We fail to issue a Payment Notice in accordance with this Clause 18(n), the sum set out in Your relevant application for payment shall become due for payment.{br}

children.name: text
children: If We wish to pay less than the sum set out in any Payment Notice (or, if no Payment Notice has been issued, the sum set out in any application for payment made by You), We shall not later than 1 day before the relevant final date for payment issue You with a written notice specifying the sum We consider to be due at the date the notice is given and the basis on which that sum is calculated (the “Pay Less Notice”). The ”Pay Less Notice” may be issued by email.{br}

children.name: text
children: (i) Where any sum due under the Sub-Contract is not paid in full by the final date for payment and We have not given a Pay Less Notice in accordance with Clause 18(o) above You shall have the right (without prejudice to any other right or remedy) to suspend performance of any or all of its obligations under the Sub-Contract.{br}{br}(ii) The right to suspend may not be exercised without the Sub-Contractor first giving to the Contractor at least seven days’ notice in writing of its intention to suspend performance, stating the ground or grounds on which it is intended to suspend performance.{br}{br}(iii) The right to suspend performance shall cease where the Contractor makes payment in full of the amount due.{br}{br}(iv) The period for completion of the Sub-Contract Works shall not take into account any period of suspension that is exercised pursuant this Clause 18(p) and accordingly such period of suspension as aforesaid shall entitle the Sub-Contractor to an extension of time equivalent to the period of suspension.{br}{br}(v) If You properly and with good cause exercise the right to suspend performance pursuant to this Clause 18 (p) You shall be entitled to recover a reasonable amount in respect of costs and expenses You reasonably incur as a result of the exercise of that right from Us. You shall comply with all of Our requests to provide any details reasonably required to ascertain such costs and expenses.{br}

children.name: text
children: (i) In the event that the Employer (or any other third party upon whom Our payment is conditional, whether directly or indirectly) is or becomes insolvent We shall not be obliged whether under the express or implied terms of the Sub-Contract or at common law or in any other way to make any payment as provided for by the Sub-Contract (including the payment of any retention monies due), except and to the extent that We have already received from the Employer an actual money payment which includes equivalent amounts which are directly attributable to the Sub-Contract Works and which are due in respect thereof.{br}{br}(ii) For the purposes of this Clause 18(q) “insolvent” shall have the meaning ascribed to it in section 113 of the Housing Grants, Construction and Regeneration Act 1996, as amended.{br}

children.name: text
children: In the event We fail to pay any sum properly due to You by the final date for payment, We shall pay interest on such overdue sum at the rate of 2% per annum above the official dealing rate of the Bank of England at the relevant final date for payment. You unconditionally agree that this rate of interest is a substantial contractual remedy pursuant to the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998.{br}

children.name: text
children: In the event You owe us any sum under this Clause 18, clauses 18(o) to 18(r) and the timetable set out therein shall apply to Your obligations and entitlements in respect of payment. Your failure to make payment within the timetable shall be a breach of contract.{br}{br}

children.name: text
children: (a) You shall comply with the provisions of the Construction Industry Scheme and any subsequent updates/revisions/superseding principles thereto.{br}{br}(b) If You fail to provide a ‘Unique Tax Reference Number’ for verification by HM Revenue & Customs then You shall not be entitled to any further payment until that number has been presented by You to Us and the number has been verified by HM Revenue & Customs.{br}{br}(c) You shall indemnify Us against any cost, loss, expense, damage, claim or other liability which We may sustain or incur as a consequence of any breach or non-compliance by You with the Construction Industry Scheme.{br}

children.name: text
children: If You default in any one or more of the following respects, that is to say:{br}{br}(i) You improperly suspend the carrying out of the Sub-Contract Works either in part or in whole before completion thereof; or{br}{br}(ii) You fail to proceed regularly and diligently with the Sub-Contract Works; or{br}{br}(iii) You refuse or neglect to comply with a written notice from Us instructing you to remove defective work or improper materials; or{br}{br}(iv) You fail to comply with the provisions of Clauses 5 or 12 of these Conditions; or{br}{br}(v) You are otherwise in breach of this Agreement and/or the Main Contract,{br}{br}We may give a written notice specifying the default and You continue such default for seven days after receipt of the notice or at any time thereafter repeat the default (whether previously having repeated it or not) We may, without prejudice to any other rights or remedies, determine Your employment under the Sub-Contract.{br}

children.name: text
children: If You become insolvent within the meaning set out in section 113 of the Housing Grants, Construction and Regeneration Act 1996, as amended, then your appointment shall terminate.{br}

children.name: text
children: In the event of Your employment being determined and so long as it has not been reinstated and continued the following shall apply:{br}{br}(i) We may employ and pay other persons to carry out and complete the Sub-Contract Works and those persons may enter upon the Site and use all goods, materials, plant, equipment, temporary works and any other items owned or hired by You intended for delivered to or placed on or adjacent to the Sub-Contract Works and may purchase all goods and materials as are necessary in order to carry out and complete the Sub-Contract Works.{br}{br}(ii) You shall indemnify Us from and against any costs, losses, damages or expenses suffered or incurred as a result of the determination allow or pay Us the amount of such costs losses damages or expenses.{br}{br}(iii) Until completion of the Sub-Contract Works and the expiry of the Defects Liability Period We shall not be bound to make any further payment to You including but not limited to any payment that has become due prior to determination but for which the final date for payment has not yet passed.{br}{br}(iv) Where Your employment has been determined pursuant to Clause 20(b), We need not pay any sum that has already become due where We have given or give a Pay Less Notice, or where You become insolvent after the last date on which a Pay Less Notice could be given by Us in respect of that sum.{br}{br}(v) At a reasonable time after completion of the Sub-Contract Works and the expiry of the Defects Liability Period We will assess the damages suffered or incurred as a result of the determination and shall make the appropriate deduction from any monies due to You. If the amount to be deducted exceeds the balance of any monies due to You the difference shall constitute a debt immediately payable by You to Us.{br}{br}(vi) You shall when instructed to do so remove from the Site any temporary buildings plant tools goods or equipment belonging to or hired by You. If within the period of time specified by Us or in the absence of such a specified timetable a reasonable time You fail to comply with Our instruction We may (but without being responsible for any loss or damage thereto) remove and sell such property and hold the proceeds, less all costs incurred by the removal and sale, on account of any sum due to Us under Clause 20(c)(ii).{br}

children.name: text
children: If for any reason Our employment under the Main Contract is determined (whether by Us or by the Employer and whether owing to any default by Us or otherwise) Your employment under the Sub-Contract shall forthwith also determine.{br}

children.name: text
children: Within 14 days of receiving notification of the determination of Our employment You shall submit to Us a final application for payment on account of the Sub-Contract Sum. You shall be entitled to payment in accordance with Clause 18(f) save that the Relevant Period shall be the period ending on the date of determination of Your employment. You shall not be entitled to any damages or other compensation by reason of such determination.{br}

children.name: text
children: Following receipt of Your final application for payment of the Sub-Contract Sum We shall within a period of not more than 7 days notify You of the payment due under Clause 18(f) and such payment becomes due in accordance with Clause 18.{br}

children.name: text
children: We reserve the right to terminate the Sub-Contract at any time by giving You two days’ notice in writing. Within 14 days of receiving notification of termination under this Clause 22, You shall submit to Us a final application for payment on account of the Sub-Contract Sum. You shall be entitled to payment in accordance with Clause 18(f) save that the Relevant Period shall be the period ending on the day two days after the date of Our notice of termination. You shall not be entitled to any damages or other compensation by reason of such termination{br}

children.name: text
children: You shall observe and comply with all applicable laws, statutes, regulations, codes and policies relating to anti-bribery and anti-corruption, including but not limited to the Bribery Act 2010.{br}

children.name: text
children: No signs will be allowed on the Site except with Our express written permission and then only on a special signboard We erect. No information of any kind whatsoever including advertising publicity matter films photographs literature including house journals sound or vision recordings radio or television broadcasts relating to the Main Contract or to the Sub-Contract shall be published given or made available to any other party nor shall it be utilised by You except with Our express prior written permission. You shall be bound by the provisions of any confidentiality or secrecy agreements We have entered into insofar as such agreements relate to the Sub-Contract Works.{br}

children.name: text
children: As soon as We agree that the Sub-Contract Works have been completed a notice to that effect shall be given to You. You shall not withdraw from the Site until such notice has been given. When You receive the notice You shall remove all plant huts and other equipment, clear away all its rubbish and leave the Site and Sub-Contract Works clean and tidy. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this clause 25 You are not relieved of Your obligations under Clause 13(h).{br}

children.name: text
children: Any claim We may have whether under this Sub-Contract or otherwise and whether present or future certain or contingent for debt or damages against You may be set-off against{br}

children.name: text
children: Any party to the Sub-Contract shall have the right to refer any dispute arising under or in connection with the Sub-Contract to adjudication in accordance with the Adjudication provisions of the Main Contract.{br}

children.name: text
children: Any dispute or difference arising under, out of, or in connection with the Sub-Contract You may have must be first pursued by way of Adjudication in accordance with clause 27(a) above and you shall not refer any dispute to final determination without having first complied with this clause 27(b).{br}

children.name: text
children: Thereafter Your dispute shall be finally determined by Court proceedings for which the jurisdiction shall be the Courts of England and Wales under English Law.{br}

children.name: text
children: We shall be entitled at our election to choose our method of dispute resolution whether by way of Arbitration or Court proceedings, for which the jurisdiction shall be the Courts of England and Wales under English Law. For the avoidance of doubt We are not obliged to refer any dispute to Adjudication prior to final determination, although We may do so if we so wish.{br}

children.name: text
children: Where arbitration is the method of dispute resolution, the arbitrator shall be a person appointed by agreement between the parties to act as arbitrator, or, failing agreement within 14 days after one party has given to the other a written request to concur in the appointment of an arbitrator, a person to be appointed on the request of either party by the president for the time being of the Law Society. Such references shall be deemed to be a submission to arbitration within the meaning of the Arbitration Act 1996 or any statutory modification thereto.{br}

children.name: text
children: Provided always that if any dispute or difference referred to arbitration under the Sub-Contract raises issues which are substantially the same as or connected with those raised in any dispute or difference arising under, out of, or in connection with the Main Contract then We may require that all such disputes or differences shall be referred to the same arbitrator and the arbitrator shall have power to make such directions and all necessary awards in the same way as if the procedure of the High Court as to joining one or more defendants or forming co-defendants or third parties was available to the parties and to him.{br}

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in the Sub-Contract, the arbitration agreement between the parties shall be amended so that the arbitrator shall have the power to open up, review, revise and/or rescind any decision, direction or order of any adjudicator appointed pursuant to these provisions provided that no such arbitration proceedings in respect of a dispute upon which the adjudicator has issued a decision shall be commenced until after completion of the Main Contract Works.{br}

children.name: text
children: Where the Main Contract is executed as a deed then as and when called upon to do so by Us You shall forthwith and at Your own cost execute the Sub-Contract Order/Agreement as a deed.{br}

children.name: text
children: If any of the provisions of the Sub-Contract shall be found to be void or unenforceable such provision shall be deemed to be deleted from the Sub-Contract and the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect.{br}

children.name: text
children: In order to be effective You must serve notices in writing upon Us either by hand or by pre-paid first class registered post or by email (all notices served by email must also be posted). All posted notices must be addressed to: The Commercial Director, Culena London Limited,, 37 upper Brook Street, Mayfair, London, W1K 7PR P. Emailed notices must be sent to the Commercial Director’s email address as detailed on Your Sub-Contract Agreement.{br}

children.name: text
children: We are be entitled to serve notices upon You by hand, by pre-paid first class registered post or by email.{br}

children.name: text
children: Notices delivered by hand shall be deemed received on the working day they were delivered, or if the notice was not delivered on a working day, on the next working day after the date of delivery. Notices sent by first class post or recorded delivery shall be deemed to be received on the second working day after the date of posting. Notices sent by email or facsimile shall be deemed to be received on the same working day that the email is sent. If any hand delivered notice email or facsimile is sent after 5:00pm or not on a working day, the notice shall be deemed to be received on the next working day.{br}

children.name: text
children: We operate the authenticated receipt procedure for value added tax purposes. Under this procedure You are required to return the authenticated receipts of payment to Us.{br}

children.name: text
children: If You fail to return the authenticated receipts in accordance with this procedure then You shall not be entitled to any further payment under this Sub Contract howsoever arsing until the appropriate authenticated receipt has been returned by You to Us. You agree that the final date for payment of any payment otherwise due under this Sub Contract is extended accordingly.{br}

children.name: text

children: {b:Covid 19 Outbreak:} the outbreak of coronavirus disease 2019 / covid 19 that was first identified in Wuhan China in December 2019 and which spread to countries around the world including the United Kingdom and which the World Health Organisation recognised as a pandemic on 11 March 2020.{br}{br}{b:Covid 19 Suspension Date:} 24th March 2020{br}{br}{b:Covid 19 Recommencement Date:} the date the carrying out of the Works is recommenced in accordance with the provisions of clause 15A.2{br}{br}{b:Covid 19 Suspension Period:} the period of time beginning on the Covid 19 Suspension Date and ending on the Covid 19 Recommencement Date{br}{br}{b:Clause 15A}{br}{b:Covid 19 Outbreak}{br}{br}15A.1 The carrying out of the Works on the Site shall be or has been suspended from the Covid 19 Suspension Date until such time as the Employer requires the carrying out of the Works on the site to be recommenced pursuant to the provisions of clause 15A.2{br}{br}15A.2 When in the opinion of the Employer acting reasonably the situation arising from the Covid 19 Outbreak has normalised sufficiently to allow a competent sub-contractor of similar size and nature to the sub-Contractor to recommence the carrying out of the Works on the Site without being unduly adversely affected by the Covid 19 Outbreak, then the Employer may by written notice to the sub-Contractor instruct the sub-Contractor to return to Site and recommence the carrying out of the Works on Site no later than 10 days after the date of receipt by the sub-Contractor of the notice.{br}{br}15A.3 The Employers notice pursuant to clause 15A.2 shall amount to an instruction pursuant to clause 3.5 but shall not amount to or be construed as a Change pursuant to clause 5.{br}{br}15A.4 On receipt of the Employers notice pursuant to clause 15A.2 the sub-Contractor shall take all steps necessary to remobilise and return to Site and recommence the Carrying out of the Works on the Covid 19 Recommencement Date.{br}{br}15A.5 The suspension of the carrying out of the Works on Site pursuant to clause 15A.1 shall be a Relevant Event for the purposes of clause 2.26.{br}{br}15A.6 The suspension of the carrying out of the Works on Site pursuant to clause 15A.1 shall not be a Relevant Matter pursuant to clause 4.21.{br}{br}15A.7 Other than an extension of time and adjustment to the Completion Date for the Works or Section pursuant to clause 2.25, the sub-Contractor shall not be entitled to any other claim, relief, remedy, compensation, reimbursement or payment of additional monies under this Contract or otherwise at law or equity arising out of the suspension of the carrying out of the Works on Site pursuant to clause 2A.1 or the Covid 19 Suspension Period.{br}{br}15A.8 During the Covid 19 Suspension Period:{br}{br}- .1 the sub-Contractor shall continue to regularly and diligently proceed with the carrying out of all elements of the Works that are not dependent upon a Site presence including but not limited to the design, the management and the procurement of the Works;{br}{br}- .2 the sub-Contractor shall take all steps necessary to minimise any delay to the completion of the Works caused by the suspension of the carrying out of the Works on Site;{br}{br}- .3 the sub-Contractor may continue to make Interim Payment Applications "(but no more frequently than once a month) in accordance with the provisions of clause 4.7 in relation to those elements of the Works referred to at clause 15A.8.2 above and the Employer shall continue to value such Interim Payment Applications and make such Interim Payments (subject to clause 15A.8.4 below) as are appropriate in accordance with the provisions of section 4 of the conditions of this Contract;{br}{br}- .4 the sub-Contractor shall at all times take all steps necessary to hold itself in readiness to remobilise and recommence the carrying out of the Works; and{br}{br}- .5 the sub-Contractor shall take all steps necessary to keep the Site safe and secure.{br}{br}15A.9 The sub-Contractor shall have no right to terminate this Contract pursuant to clause 8.11 or otherwise under this Contract or otherwise at law or equity in the event the Covid 19 Suspension Period exceeds 2 months{br}{br}15A,10 In the event the Covid 19 Suspension Period exceeds 6 months then the Employer in its sole discretion may terminate the sub-Contractors engagement under this Contract by 7 days written notice to the sub-Contractor{br}
